registry_date_HE: 12026年7月19日（人类纪元；对应公元2026年7月19日）
purpose: Registry of known source categories, their typical rights status, and required governance actions for each. Used by Q33 publication gate and External Input Non-Republication Principle.

public_domain.label: Public Domain
public_domain.description: Works whose copyright has expired, been dedicated, or never existed

open_license_cc_by_nc_sa.label: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0
examples: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (used by this project for documents)

open_license_agpl.label: GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later
open_license_agpl.description: Strong copyleft license for network use

open_license_apache.label: Apache License 2.0
examples: Apache 2.0 (used by this project for public interfaces/schema)

open_license_busl.label: Business Source License 1.1
open_license_busl.description: Source-available license converting to AGPL after change date

third_party_course_material.label: Third-party course material / paid content
third_party_course_material.description: Materials from paid courses, textbooks, or proprietary educational platforms
prohibited_actions: Use for commercial purposes without explicit license
Claim fair use without jurisdiction-specific analysis
permitted_actions: Brief quotation under fair dealing/fair use if applicable

third_party_paywall_article.label: Third-party paywall-protected article
third_party_paywall_article.description: Articles behind paywalls owned by publishers or authors

third_party_private_note.label: Third-party private notes / restricted materials
third_party_private_note.description: Materials obtained through private channels, access-gated systems, or personal accounts
prohibited_actions: Any republication without explicit written permission from rights holder AND access provider
Using materials obtained through unauthorized access
third_party_private_note.notes: Even if a work is public domain, accessing it through a paywalled/private system creates additional contractual obligations.

government_publication.label: Government publication / official text
government_publication.description: Official legislative texts, court decisions, government reports

platform_policy_document.label: Platform policy document
platform_policy_document.description: Terms of service, DMCA policies, community guidelines published by platforms

ai_generated_content.label: AI-generated content
ai_generated_content.notes: US Copyright Office has ruled that purely AI-generated works lack human authorship and are not copyrightable. However, human-authored elements mixed with AI output may be protectable. This area is evolving.

project_original_content.label: Project original content
project_original_content.description: Content originally created for this repository

publication_gate_decision_tree.step_4: If PERMISSION_REQUIRED → BLOCK publication until permission obtained
publication_gate_decision_tree.step_5: If COUNSEL_REQUIRED → FLAG for legal review before publication
publication_gate_decision_tree.step_6: If PROCEED_* → Publish with required provenance recording
